required_fixes: DESIGN must populate spec.json.target_pool.seeds with candidate seed URLs and run the frozen hop-confirmation crawl (static same-host <a> BFS, depth<=6, budget 250) during DESIGN to admit >=10 DEEP items with >=2 distinct hosts/engines each having >=3 DEEP items (VN-V2, admission_gate ADMISSION_GATE_V2).

DESIGN must verify and record live evidence for all three pre-freeze control certificate conditions in spec.json.pre_freeze_control_certificate before freeze: (a) pool DEEP admission on >=2 hosts/engines, (b) >=1 discovery channel probeable on >=1 pool host with HTTP 200 + parsable entries, (c) null control synthetic items yield 0 reachable URLs on all channels (VN-V9, prereg §14). Freeze proceeds ONLY if all_verified=true with evidence_refs populated.

DESIGN must resolve all open design decisions listed in prereg.md §18 (final seed list, synthetic identifier format, search query-parameter mapping per host, JSON-LD @type vocabulary, sitemap.gz handling, redirect accounting in K=3, engine definition for multi-generator same-domain sites) and freeze them in spec.json before freeze.json is created.

For design-contract v2, the freeze_eligibility checks (decision_rule_reachability, measurement_prerequisites, baseline_identifiability, control_sensitivity, treatment_liveness, freeze_artifacts_bound) would catch this defect class at DESIGN review; a fresh v2 design should be used for the re-freeze.

The deterministic freezer must bind the pool/crawl/certificate artifacts via freeze.json.artifact_hashes (freeze_artifacts_bound) so the sampling frame is immutably pinned at freeze time, not just the three canonical text files.

validity_findings.description: The frozen spec.json.target_pool admits zero seeds, zero confirmed DEEP items, and zero hosts. VN-V2 requires the pool to be frozen at DESIGN time with live hop-confirmation crawl confirming DEEP items on >=2 engines. The frozen record shows pool_deep_items_confirmed=false, pool_deep_hosts_confirmed=false. There is no sampling frame to measure; the primary metric denominator is 0.

VN-V9 and prereg §14 explicitly state: 'Freeze proceeds ONLY if all three are verified.' The frozen pre_freeze_control_certificate has all_verified=false, verified_at=null, discovery_channel_probe_verified=false, null_control_verified=false, evidence_refs=[]. The freeze committed despite the design's own mandatory gate being unfulfilled. This is a control-plane/governance failure, not a scientific outcome.

The frozen decision_rule.primary_metric = count(reachable DEEP items) / count(admitted DEEP items). As frozen, denominator = 0, so the fraction is 0/0 (undefined). Neither SUPPORTS (fraction >=0.50 on >=2 engines) nor FALSIFIES (fraction <0.50 on >=2 engines) is arithmetically reachable. The MIXED and INCONCLUSIVE mappings also require evaluable per-engine metrics. This is the exact 'empty-accept-region / unsatisfiable-predicate' failure class the director_mandate.agent_priors_used[8] warns about.

prereg.md §18 lists seven unresolved design decisions that 'must be resolved and frozen in spec.json before freeze.json is created': final seed list, synthetic identifier format, search query-parameter mapping, JSON-LD vocabulary, sitemap.gz handling, redirect accounting, engine definition. None are resolved in the frozen spec.json. The freeze therefore committed an incomplete design.

freeze.json contains only the three canonical hashes (request.json, spec.json, prereg.md). It binds no pool, seed-list, raw-crawl-log, or certificate artifact via artifact_hashes. For a design whose validity depends entirely on a frozen sampling frame, the absence of artifact binding means the sampling frame identity is not pinned anywhere in the repository.

All four frozen controls (PC_DISCOVERY_CHANNEL_REACHABILITY, NC_SYNTHETIC_UNREACHABLE_ITEM, B_LINK_FOLLOWING_BFS, B_PERSISTED_PATH_REACQUISITION, B_DIRECT_URL_REPLAY) are reported UNKNOWN because the frozen design assigned their execution to DESIGN pre-freeze (VN-V9, prereg §14). The positive control required live channel probe evidence in the certificate; the null control required frozen synthetic identifiers; the baselines required the frozen pool's admitted items. None were ever given the chance to run. This is consistent with the producer's UNKNOWN (not FAIL) classification.

Baselines B_LINK_FOLLOWING_BFS, B_PERSISTED_PATH_REACQUISITION, B_DIRECT_URL_REPLAY are carried from EXP-FRONTIER-37950626378. The parent handoff explicitly rejects its single-host/single-engine mdBook DEEP band as a substitute for the required >=2-engine pool (parent handoff dependencies, carry_forward.do_not_assume). The producer correctly treats these as inherited context only, not as measurements of this experiment.

TCP 443 connectivity to candidate hosts (doc.rust-lang.org, www.gnu.org, quotes.toscrape.com, example.com) succeeded within 4s (OBS-ENV-01). Python 3.12.15 stdlib HTTP substrate is available. The BLOCKED status is correctly attributed to the unsatisfiable frozen design, not infrastructure failure. This is properly disclosed in VN-B9.

The producer correctly classifies this as a design/control-plane defect record (status=BLOCKED, outcome=NOT_APPLICABLE), not MEASUREMENT_INVALID (no measurement was taken to invalidate) and not a scientific FALSIFIES. No claim update is warranted. C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY and C-WEB-DYNAMICS retain their Codex effective statuses (EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440 and EXP-PHYSICS-37973239386 respectively). This is properly documented in VN-B10.

recomputed_metrics.discovery_reachable_fraction_per_engine_: No host/engine has admitted DEEP items in frozen record; per-engine fraction non-computable.
recomputed_metrics.discovery_reachable_fraction_per_channel: No discovery channel probed; frozen design requires per-channel coverage but item set is empty.

recomputed_metrics.RED_requests_vs_discovery_GETs_reason: Paired comparison requires same admitted item set for RED and discovery; item set is empty.

Frozen design's sampling frame and pre-freeze certificate are empty; constructing pool post-freeze would mutate frozen design (VN-V2, VN-V9, prereg §14, §19), so no confirmatory measurement possible under frozen transaction.

claim_ceiling: No scientific claim is supportable from this frozen transaction. The experiment's hypothesis (site-native discovery reaches >=50% of DEEP items in <=3 GETs on >=2 engines) remains entirely untested. The frozen design violates its own pre-freeze gates (VN-V9, prereg §14), admits zero DEEP items across zero hosts, and leaves all open design decisions unresolved (prereg §18). The falsifier is arithmetically unsatisfiable in both directions (denominator=0). C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY and C-WEB-DYNAMICS retain their Codex effective epistemic statuses (EXPERIMENTAL and HYPOTHESIS respectively per codex/claim_state.json). This packet provides a verifiable design-defect receipt, not scientific evidence.
unresolved: Whether any non-mdBook host admits DEEP (hop>=3) items within B=250/D=6 remains unknown (carried from EXP-FRONTIER-37950626378 UR-1); it is a prerequisite for the cross-engine contrast this experiment requires.

Whether site-native discovery channels reach DEEP items in <=K=3 GETs on >=2 engines remains UNMEASURED; nothing in this receipt answers it, and it must not be read as either a positive or negative answer.

Whether the discovery question is the right next investment versus the explicitly recorded maintenance/invalidation axis (re-validation GETs/bytes plus stale-replay false-accept rate vs re-derivation cost, per parent handoff next_question alternative) is a Global Research Director allocation decision.

Why the DESIGN stage froze a spec whose own pre-freeze gating obligations (VN-V9, prereg §14) were unfulfilled, and why the deterministic freezer committed a v1 packet without artifact binding for the sampling frame, are control-plane/governance questions for the factory (freezer, DESIGN reviewer, or lane governance); this packet records the defect but cannot fix it retroactively.

A satisfiable re-freeze requires: (1) re-open DESIGN for the same director mandate; (2) curate candidate seeds; (3) run frozen hop-confirmation crawl; (4) admit >=10 DEEP items with >=2 hosts/engines >=3 each; (5) verify >=1 discovery channel and null control live; (6) populate spec.json.target_pool and pre_freeze_control_certificate with evidence_refs; (7) resolve all prereg §18 decisions; (8) re-freeze with artifact_hashes binding the pool/crawl/certificate. A design-contract v2 design with freeze_eligibility checks would make this defect class impossible to freeze.
